basic_info.description: Are you in search of an exceptional investment opportunity or considering a 1031 Exchange? Look no further than 138-140 Lower Terrace. This property underwent a substantial renovation and expansion in 2016, enhancing its appeal and functionality. The lower flat, 138, boasts 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms spread across two levels, offering exclusive access to a charming garden and garage. Meanwhile, the upper unit, spanning a single level, features 4 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. Notably, residents of the upper unit enjoy exclusive use of a stunning rooftop deck boasting breathtaking bay views. Both units are equipped with radiant heat in the bathrooms and showcase elegant marble floors complemented by light wood flooring throughout.  Pictures (36)
